# DefectAwareCompactModel

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A physics-based compact model for ferroelectric nanocapacitors that incorporates defect dynamics to accurately predict polarization switching behavior. Enables realistic circuit-level simulation of ferroelectric devices, critical for designing reliable in-memory computing and neuromorphic hardware.
